source.label: CoolStuffInc / GatheringMagic.com, "GenCon Vintage Championships" (15 August 2009), lists supplied by the organizer, Pastimes

notes.text: No Wizards coverage of the 2009 Vintage Championship was found. CoolStuffInc places the Top 8 1 to 8 without a bracket or seeds; places 3 and 4 are given here as 3-4 and places 5 to 8 as 5-8.
CoolStuffInc prints no archetype names; archetypes are the names on the lhc Deckbox sets.
MTG Salvation reposted the eight lists with archetype names but no player names.
CoolStuffInc prints the name family name first, "Itou Hiromichi".
Printed with 61 main deck cards and a 13-card sideboard; the Deckbox copy agrees.
CoolStuffInc prints "1 Windfall ???", flagging the card as uncertain.
